questions: how can i book a lab test
faqs.answer:
You can book your test through:
1. Phone Call
2. WhatsApp
3. Visit our nearest MBL branch
Some tests require fasting while others do not. Our team will inform you about any preparation needed when you book your test.

questions: book a test without a doctor's prescription
faqs.answer: Yes, health/general checkups can be booked without a prescription. Certain specialised tests may require a doctor's recommendation.

questions: do you offer health checkup packages
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer 5 comprehensive, exclusive health checkup packages.

To ensure accurate test results:
1. Fast for 10–12 hours before your appointment (water is allowed unless instructed otherwise).
2. Avoid alcohol and non-veg meals the day before.

questions: children and senior citizens undergo testing
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer tests for all age groups.

questions: how long does it take to receive test reports
faqs.answer:
Report delivery depends on the test type:
1. Routine tests — within 6 hours or same day
2. Specialised tests — 1–3 working days
3. Advanced tests — as per test requirement

questions: how can i access my test reports
faqs.answer: Reports can be received through: Email, WhatsApp, Online Patient Portal, or a printed copy from the laboratory.
Yes. Patients can securely access and download their reports online through our patient web portal. Reports can also be shared via email or WhatsApp upon request.

questions: cancellation policy if the technician is already on the way
faqs.answer: If the technician has already reached your location and the appointment is cancelled, the home collection service charge will be deducted. Any remaining amount, if applicable, will be processed according to the laboratory's refund policy.

Refunds for pre-paid bookings are processed based on the cancellation policy. If the booking is cancelled before the technician starts the journey, the full amount will be refunded. If the technician has already reached your location, the home collection service charge will be deducted and the remaining amount, if applicable, will be refunded. Refunds are typically credited to the original payment method within the applicable processing time.

questions: verify the identity of the technician
faqs.answer: You can verify the technician's identity by viewing their photo and details in the app before the scheduled visit.

faqs.answer: Yes, you can book multiple tests.
